description: This file defines the 'Polyline' class for drawing polyline overlays on a map within the Leaflet mapping library. It extends the 'Path' class, provides various methods for managing polyline points, bounds, and rendering, and includes documentation and an example usage.

classes.name: Polyline
classes.description: A class extending 'Path' for drawing and managing polyline overlays on a map, including methods for point management, calculations, and rendering.

methods.name: getLatLngs
methods.description: Returns an array of the points in the polyline, which can be nested arrays for multi-polyline shapes.

methods.name: setLatLngs
methods.description: Replaces all points in the polyline with a given array of geographical points.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if the polyline has no points.

methods.name: closestLayerPoint
methods.description: Calculates and returns the point on the polyline closest to a given point.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Calculates and returns the centroid (center point) of the polyline.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the geographic bounds of the polyline.

methods.name: addLatLng
methods.description: Adds a new point to the polyline, optionally specifying which part to add to.

methods.name: _setLatLngs
methods.description: Internal method to set internal state with given points and calculate bounds.

methods.name: _convertLatLngs
methods.description: Internal method to convert input points into LatLng instances and update bounds.

methods.name: _project
methods.description: Calculates projected pixel bounds and sets up internal rings for rendering.

methods.name: _updateBounds
methods.description: Calculates and updates the pixel bounds for hit detection.

methods.name: _clipPoints
methods.description: Clips the polyline to the renderer bounds for performance optimization.

methods.name: _simplifyPoints
methods.description: Simplifies the polyline points for performance using the specified smooth factor.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Handles updating the polyline, including clipping and path update.

methods.name: _updatePath
methods.description: Invokes the renderer to update the visual path of the polyline.

methods.name: _containsPoint
methods.description: Hit detection method to determine if a point is within proximity of the polyline.
